subject: Re: Temporary overrun / safety-net for launch week
messages:
From: Sara Levin <sara@clearsight.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: sales@clearsight.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need short-term burst & pricing guardrail for launch week

Jordan —

Hope you had a great weekend. Quick ask: our product launch is scheduled for Aug 18 and the marketing plan has a couple of spikes that could push our inference usage 6–8x baseline for 48–72 hours. We want to avoid throttles but don’t want an open-ended bill shock.

Can Redwood provide a temporary headroom allocation for launch (no more than 72h), with a pre-agreed rate ceiling and a 30-day true-up so finance can forecast? If possible, we’d like a provisional uplift now (short approval) and a retro true-up invoice after the period. Also: any discount for committed monthly spend if we convert to a short-term higher commit after launch?

Attached is our launch runbook and a traffic profile.

—Sara
Sara Levin
Head of Platform
ClearSight Analytics
Attachments: CS-Launch-Plan-v2.pdf (doc), traffic-profile.csv (csv)
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Sara Levin <sara@clearsight.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need short-term burst & pricing guardrail for launch week

Sara — thanks for the context and the runbook. Congrats on the launch — looks solid.

Quick proposal to get you covered without surprise charges:
- Provision a temporary 72-hour headroom pool sized at estimated peak (we can cap at the 8x figure you sent).
- Blended provisional rate for overrun tokens during that window: $0.0028 / token (volume-weighted), capped at a 20% premium over your current committed unit rate.
- 30-day invoice true-up after the window; if you convert the uplift into a short-term monthly commit within 14 days of the true-up, we apply a conversion rebate that credits 50% of the provisional premium back as an offset.

Operational guardrails (from Monica):
- Auto-fallback to a smaller model variant if 95th pct latency SLOs would be violated for more than 5 minutes.
- Prefix caching for repeat queries to reduce effective token burn.

Next steps: if that sounds acceptable I’ll draft the provisional addendum and the temporary PO path. Any hard limit for the provisional spend you want enforced (we can attach a card cap/payment guard)? Also looping Monica for the runtime constraints.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Tel: +1 415 555 0194
Attachments: provisional-pricing-sheet.xlsx
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Sara Levin <sara@clearsight.ai>, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need short-term burst & pricing guardrail for launch week

Hi Sara —

A couple quick operational notes from infra/CS:
- We can reserve an isolated Dedicated headroom pool for the 72h window; that gives you predictable throughput and avoids noisy-neighbor issues.
- We’ll pre-provision KV cache warmers ahead of the traffic spike window (two warmers: 12h and 1h before expected peak) to reduce per-token costs.
- If you want a hard spend cap, we can gate the pool with a pre-authorized payment method and an escrow threshold; once the cap is hit, traffic will route to your baseline tier (not throttled) and we’ll alert your on-call.

Question for Sara: Can you confirm the expected peak start/end window (local time) and whether any single endpoint will account for >70% of traffic? That changes routing and warm-up plan.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Levin <sara@clearsight.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need short-term burst & pricing guardrail for launch week

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. Couple of follow-ups from finance before we sign:
1) Can the provisional premium be reduced to a flat $0.0024/token if we agree to a 3-month trial commit of 25% uplift post-launch? Finance is concerned about the interim spike but willing to move faster if the post-launch economics are clearer.
2) We’d like the spend cap to be $12,000 for the window. If we hit it, automatic fallback to baseline is fine.

If both are doable, I’ll approve the provisional addendum and route to procurement for PO. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Sara
Sara Levin
Head of Platform, ClearSight Analytics
phone: +1 415 890 2201
